ruleset.name: Stratum tests
ruleset.description: The structure of Stratum's own tests.

rule.name: TestOutsideNestedGroups
rule.message: Move this test into the @Nested group for its behaviour: a class that groups its tests keeps none beside the groups (ST-TEST-17).
rule.description: A test method (@Test, @ParameterizedTest, @RepeatedTest, @TestFactory or @TestTemplate) directly in a class that also declares a @Nested class, at any level. A flat class with no @Nested class, which ST-TEST-17 allows for one behaviour, is never reported.

rule.name: TestDataInValueSource
rule.message: Feed the data of this test from a documented private static final constant with @FieldSource, not an inline @ValueSource (ST-TEST-15).
rule.description: An inline @ValueSource. Only this part of ST-TEST-15 is checked: @MethodSource, and whether the constant is documented, are left to review.
